name: What is the process for fascia board replacement?
description: The fascia replacement process involves inspection, removal of old fascia, installation of new boards, reattachment of gutters, and cleanup.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for fascia board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fascia board replacement process typically begins with a thorough inspection to assess the damage and determine the best approach. Our team will then carefully remove the old, damaged fascia and any attached gutters. Next, new fascia boards are cut to size, primed, and securely installed. Finally, gutters are reattached or new ones installed, and the area is cleaned. This systematic approach ensures a durable and aesthetically pleasing result. We coordinate with you throughout the process to ensure minimal disruption to your daily routine.
